designs.title: No.
designs.why: Reads instantly from across the shop: the unimpressed cat draped over a fat 'NO' with its paw pinning the ball as the full stop is a clean, giftable cat-attitude joke. Confident one-ink line work, the face carries real personality, the whiskers and fur flicks hold up at full size, and it inverts well onto the black tee. What holds it back is coherence: the cat body is pure open outline while the tail is dense vertical hatching and the letters have their own white-slash texture, so there are three rendering styles fighting each other, and the heavy tail block on the left pulls the eye off the face and makes the left side bottom-heavy.
designs.fix: Unify the textures: redraw the tail in the same open outline (with a few fur flicks) as the body, or carry the letters' slash texture into it, so the left edge stops being a dark block and the eye goes straight to the face, the NO and the ball.
